_comment: SB2-21 goldens, written by hand. Stack and body heights come from Samtec's drawings (sources below); the frames from the footprints' own geometry (README, 'Expected frames'); board thickness and positions are fixture choices. Nothing here is computed by Prism.

sources.parts: ADM6-30-03.5-L-4-0-A-TR terminals (base) and ADF6-30-03.5-L-4-0-A-TR sockets (top): the JTYU OBC-to-CMBD pair
sources.matedHeight: Samtec ADX6 MATED VIEWS rev E, Table 1: ADM6 lead style -03.5 with ADF6 lead style -03.5, "A" = 7.00 mm nominal, 7.46 max (dimensions for Samtec's recommended PCB layouts)
sources.terminalBodyHeight: Samtec ADM6-XXX-XX.X-XXX-4-X-X-XR rev AA, Table 3, lead style -03.5: "G" = 4.900 mm
sources.socketBodyHeight: Samtec ADF6-XXX-XX.X-XXX-4-X-X-XR rev Y, Table 7, lead style -03.5: "K" = 3.230 mm
sources.footprints: Samtec recommended PCB layouts ADM6-XXX-XX.X-XXX-X-X-X-FOOTPRINT rev G and ADF6-XXX-XX.X-XXX-X-X-X-FOOTPRINT rev H, sheet 1: 0.635 mm pitch; rows A-D 3.50 and B-C 1.58 apart; pads 0.356 mm; -30 envelope 23.77 x 5.00 mm; -A NPTHs 0.950 mm, 21.22 mm apart, one 1.27 mm off the centreline

topPoseInBaseFrame._comment: Board frames of CONTRACTS_P2 §14 (z = 0 at the mid-plane). The top board sits directly over the base, unflipped (its sockets are on its bottom side): 0.8 (half the base) + 7.0 (mated height) + 0.8 (half the top).

clearance._comment: CONTRACTS_P2 §14.5 fallback with the datasheet body heights (sources: terminalBodyHeight G, socketBodyHeight K) over the courtyards: 4.90 + 3.23 + 5.00 margin = 13.13; the top board at 0.8 + 13.13 + 0.8. With no bodies at all the courtyards stand 5.00 mm each: 5 + 5 + 5 = 15.00, top at 16.60.

mezzanineShifted._comment: The next commit of mezz_top moves J2 +1.5 mm in X. Posed from J1, pair J2 misses by 1.5 mm (SYS-V11, M4).

frameConfidence._comment: CONTRACTS_P2 §15.1. The Samtec footprints, like JTYU's, name no orientation, so their frames come from the body over the pads (medium); the stock 2.54 mm parts say _Vertical or _Horizontal (high).

pairs._comment: Which connectors mate. edge_a J1 (right-angle header) into edge_b J1 (vertical socket) is the orthogonal assembly; edge_a J2 (right-angle socket) with edge_b J2 (right-angle header) is the coplanar one. KiCad's generic 2.54 mm parts have no manufacturer drawing, so their poses are not goldens here.
